name: @local/media-senses
description: Perception, reproduction and quality assurance for LLM agents: watch videos and images (blind or vision-targeted reports), listen to music with a beat grid you can cut to, learn a genre from a corpus, synthesise sound effects and build videos with ffmpeg + local TTS + headless-browser code animations, then prove the result against the reference (acceptance gate, aesthetic rules, pixel QA, independent review).
